Full summary: Contracts builder (harness foundation-trial): wrote spec.schema.json, types.ts, class-map.json, reason-codes.json, build-specs.mjs (dependency-free validator + byte materialisation + TELL-SCAN), the C01.dev worked example (spec, 4 stage prompts, golden + adversarial answer sets) and README under twining-benchmark-harness/src/scenarios/foundation-trial/. build-specs --check passes; types.ts compiles under the repo's strict flags; a throwaway reference scorer shows golden PASS 56/56 and adversarial FAIL 56/56. No files in twining-mcp changed.
Decisions: U-9 resolved: EV-A10/EV-K20 (authenticated_human_action archive) map to a v3 lifecycle event kind `archived` on the target, ingress adapter, class human_statement, producer = the acting human, signed with the human key (capability write) — chose this over a human_ruling stating the archival because ceremony admits only human_ruling and human_ruling is reserved for ruling records (validate.ts RECORD_TYPE_CLASS_MISMATCH), so a ruling would misrepresent an archival as an authority act; fallback to the ruling form only if SEED-DRY refuses, decided before the freeze. Consequence recorded: archived records are excluded from EventStore.query and the working set unless include_archived, so C04 vacuity must query include_archived and packet coverage will show the archived target as not delivered.; Reason-code union fixed at 27 codes: the 24 named in design §4 plus source_state_unknown (C04 A1/B1 pre-fixed disjunction), statement_is_not_ruling and caller_asserted_field_non_authorizing (one non-authorizing code per non-authorizing class-map row); derived renderings use reported_result_non_authorizing — rejected adding a separate derived_rendering code as redundant with the class map.; A16 write_forbidden is scoped to stages 0 and 1 rather than the design example's stage "*" — after evt-c01-005 exists a journal note that Mara approves b299f5a7 is true, and a stage-* scan would flag it; the head_b_current claim regex was tightened for the same reason (the design-shaped regex matched the golden's truthful 'current head is unknown; the last-known head b299f5a7').; Prompts carry the reason-code list and decision words literally (frozen bytes = seen bytes) with exactly two run-time placeholders {{arm_pointer}} and {{ceiling_inline}}; build-specs asserts each prompt names every code, word, (qid), action, now and answer file — chosen over run-time substitution so the pre-registration hash covers what the agent sees.; Policy and principal authorities are top-level spec objects (policy, identities) rendered by every seeder as two records (policy.record_id, identities.record_id) signed by a synthetic steward human in v3, rather than entries in records[] — avoids duplicating the authority table the v3 membership is built from.; Severity is required on every fact and authority_changing is read as severity=authority AND category in {authorization, consumer_prerequisite} AND kind in {decision, cited_exclude, write_forbidden, reason_code_forbidden} — the §6 line is ambiguous about whether '(severity authority)' qualifies only reason_code_forbidden; flagged as an open question.
